sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2024
sources.text: While underway, the crew saw six perpetrators armed with knives at the stern. The master raised the alarm, mustered the crew and reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). All crew members were accounted for, and no injuries were reported. Some engine spare parts were stolen. The master indicated that no further assistance was required, and continued its journey to Fang Cheng, China. Safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore Police Coast Guard were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.
